normative_extracts.quote: history.replaceState(data, unused, url) updates the current session history entry URL without triggering a document reload.
The URLSearchParams interface defines utility methods to work with the query string of a URL.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Partitions client state by source of truth and persistence lifetime across component memory, URLSearchParams, server cache machines, and IndexedDB.

production_failures.symptom: Throttled History API error and frozen filter bar during slider drag
production_failures.root_cause: Binding continuous range slider input events directly to history.replaceState() exceeds browser IPC rate limits (100 calls per 30s in Safari/Chromium).
production_failures.mitigation: Keep transient drag state in ephemeral component memory and commit to URLSearchParams only on pointerup or debounced settle.

production_failures.symptom: User edits vanish after background refetch completes
production_failures.root_cause: Server response overwrites local form state because fetched entities and unsaved draft edits share the same store slice.
production_failures.mitigation: Separate server cache snapshots from ephemeral or IndexedDB-backed draft buffers keyed by dirty state.
